_comment: PRD #439 friction baseline — the ledger of CURRENTLY-ACCEPTED friction findings measured against tests/e2e/fixtures/crewops-snapshot via the real CLI sequence (adopt -> heal -> audit --fix -> front door). This is the ratchet: a finding whose key is NOT here is a regression and FAILS the gate. Keys may only be REMOVED across commits, never added. Closing a friction-fix issue means deleting its key here AND the gate confirming the finding no longer reproduces (see docs/agents/friction-loop.md). RED on day one is intended — every entry is a tracked defect with a removal trigger (ADR-0003).
